sources.title: OvisOCR2 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: In this report, we present OvisOCR2, a compact 0.8B end-to-end model for page-level document parsing. We build a data engine that combines filtered real-document annotations with source-aligned synthetic pages, and use a training recipe that applies supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, on-policy distillation, and model fusion.

sources.snippet: We introduce OvisOCR2, a 0.8B document parsing model. OvisOCR2 is designed as an end-to-end parser: given a document page image, it generates a Markdown representation in natural reading order, covering text, formulas, tables, and visual regions.
